text:
mira.k: Heads up 1 — Prospect NovaLedger wants a 2-week Dedicated POC with a single egress IP to add to their firewall.
sam.r: Doable? They also asked for a short compliance note about logging and data residency.
eva.ops: We can allocate a single static egress IP for a POC as an add-on. Provisioning lead time ~48h after PO. IP stays fixed for the POC unless customer asks for reprovisioning.
jamie.sec: Security notes: TLS enforced. We can provide SOC2 summary and data retention excerpt. We cannot offer mTLS on hosted Dedicated; that's Private only. We can redact tenant IDs in exported logs but operational flow logs exist. I'll prepare a short SQA answer.
mira.k: What do I need from customer to start provisioning?
eva.ops: Ask for: 1) Network contact + email, 2) exact single IP (or acceptance of our single EIP), 3) peak RPS/tokens to size the pool, 4) PO for egress addon, 5) region constraint (if any).
sam.r: I'll request that. Also give me a one-line curl they can run once we hand over the IPs.
eva.ops: Use this: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer POC_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"ping"}'
mira.k: Sales will include a dedicated line item: "POC static egress (14d)" with cost and ETA.
deploy-bot: PROV-5012 created  Dedicated POC static-egress for novaledger-42. Assigned eva.ops. ETA 48h.
sam.r: Thanks — I'll send the customer the checklist and attach Jamie's compliance blurb once it's ready.
